title: Detailed island with a palm tree
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Sky glow / horizon suggestion - subtle, no background fill -->
  <!-- Ocean water -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="78" rx="48" ry="16" fill="#1a5fa8"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="78" rx="48" ry="14" fill="#2d7dd2"/>

  <path d="M10 76 Q20 73 30 76" stroke="#6ec6ff" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <circle cx="45" cy="40" r="3" fill="#5c3a1e"/>

  <!-- Back fronds (darker) -->

  <path d="M44 33 Q55 18 68 22 Q56 24 48 30 Q45 30 44 33" fill="#2d8a3e"/>

  <path d="M38 70 Q37 68 39 68 Q41 68 40 70Z" fill="#ffd4e8"/>
